column2: Lilmoth Dock is a short walk to the north-east. The walled part of Lilmoth is a longer walk to the north-west. Flaa Heet's village lies a short walk to the south-west.
Wild leeks grow a few paces to the north-west. Yellow mountain flower grows a few paces to the east, down by the water. A poison bloom grows a short walk to the east-north-east.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants runs it. It has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
I am a mage for hire, and I cast fire. I keep a ward up while my companions and I travel. I chose Lilmoth for its Hist tree and its old Imperial ruins, and I read about both.
